quotations.old_english: Defrutum, i. vinum medo geswét vel weall

source_text: weall, es; n. (?) Boiled or mulled wine:--Defrutum, i. vinum medo geswét vel weall (cf. gesoden wín defrutum vinum, i. 27, 62. Coerin defrutum, cyren oððe áwylled wín dulcisapa, ii. 25, 10, 69. Ásodenes wínes careni, Hpt. Gl. 408, 42), Wrt. Voc. ii. 138, 24. Níwes &l-bar; ge&dash-uncertain;sodenes wealles defruti &l-bar; medoni, Hpt. Gl. 414, 1. Wealle defruto, vino, 520, 38.
